idea.dissect.description: an LLM splits the idea into typed items, each citing its span; moves the dissection to a new revision; not once the current dissection is valid

questions.answer.description: accept each default or change it: a human for every scope-changing question; moves the questions to a new revision; not once the interview is settled

questions.check.description: check the interview's shape and whether it is settled

questions.write.description: an LLM writes one question per open item, with options and a default answer; moves the questions to a new revision; not once the current interview is valid

requirements.normalise.description: normalise the facts, wishes and answers into the requirements list; moves the requirements to a new revision; not once the current requirements list is valid

dissection.description: dissection.yaml, the idea's typed items: fact, wish, belief, unknown, ambiguity, dark spot

idea.description: idea.yaml, an sdc.intake.Idea instance; its revision is the file's sha256

questions.description: questions.yaml, the interview: one question per open item, each with a default answer and its answer, accepted or changed

requirements.description: requirements.yaml, the structural, product-level list of what should be built, each entry citing a fact, a wish or an answer

dissection.valid.description: the current dissection is valid, made from the current idea revision

idea.shaped.description: the current idea record is a valid sdc.intake.Idea

questions.settled.description: every open item of the current dissection has a settled question

questions.shaped.description: the current interview is valid, every question with a default answer

requirements.valid.description: the current requirements list is valid, normalised from the current interview

dissection_shape.description: the dissection check: schema-valid, every item one of the six types, every span a substring of the idea text; its result is valid or invalid

idea_shape.description: `ess generate schema validate` over idea.yaml; its result is valid or invalid

questions_settled.description: the interview check: every open item (belief, unknown, ambiguity, dark spot) has exactly one question, every question is answered accepted or changed, every scope-changing one by a human; its result is settled, open or needs_human

questions_shape.description: `ess generate schema validate` over questions.yaml, every question with a default answer; its result is valid or invalid

requirements_shape.description: the requirements check: schema-valid, every requirement cites a fact, a wish or an answer; its result is valid or invalid

dissection.revised.description: an interview check observed against an earlier dissection no longer applies

idea.revised.description: a dissection check observed against an earlier idea revision no longer applies

questions.revised.description: a requirements check observed against an earlier interview no longer applies

dissection.required.description: the idea is dissected into typed items

interview.required.description: every open item is asked and settled

passed.description: the idea is dissected, the interview settled and the requirements list valid

protocol.description: Turn an idea into a requirements list (docs/phases.md steps 1 to 3). The idea record is checked against its schema; the idea is dissected into typed items (fact, wish, belief, unknown, ambiguity, dark spot), each citing its span of the idea; every open item becomes an interview question with a default answer, accepted as is or changed, every scope-changing one by a human; the answers are normalised into a requirements list. Every result is a program's exit status, never an LLM's word. A revised idea invalidates the dissection check, a revised dissection the interview check, a revised interview the requirements check. The case ends passed; abandoning the idea is the root case's decision.
